Asset.title: Asset
Asset.description: A company-owned item issued to employees (laptop, phone, vehicle, tool, accessPass, clothing, other): identity fields (serialNumber, licencePlate for vehicles), acquisition fields, and a guarded custody state machine (asset-management-mvp). A vehicle Asset additionally carries the fiscal facts (listPrice, fuelType, companyCarTaxCategory) the monthly bijtelling privegebruik auto calculation needs (hrmq-asset-fleet-merge, absorbed from the retired Vehicle schema) -- required exactly when category is vehicle, enforced by the corpus rule nl-asset-voertuig-fiscale-velden-compleet (a schema-level conditional cannot express this: Schema::getSchemaObject() never emits allOf/if/then to the validator, design.md D2). No AssetHistoryEntry: OpenRegister's object audit trail already records every mutation.

issue.description: The asset is handed to an employee (recorded by an AssetAssignment with a matching issuedOn).

checkIn.description: The asset is returned and awaiting check. Deliberately the only exit from issued -- an issued asset must be checked in (or its loss recorded here) before it can be written off.

release.description: Checked and back in stock, re-issuable via issue.

writeOff.description: Written off. Terminal. Not reachable from issued by design (design.md D1).

category.title: Category
category.description: Kind of asset. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

serialNumber.title: Serial number
serialNumber.description: Serial number; null for uncoded items (clothing, accessPass).

licencePlate.title: Licence plate
licencePlate.description: Dutch licence plate -- meaningful for category vehicle. Carries no fiscal semantics by itself; the fiscal facts live in listPrice/fuelType/companyCarTaxCategory below.

status.title: Status
status.description: Custody lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (available -> issued -> checkedIn -> available, or available/checkedIn -> writtenOff, terminal).

active.title: Active
active.description: Administrative visibility toggle (the OrgUnit convention), distinct from the custody lifecycle.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this Asset is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); an Asset has no single owning employee, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema. Maintained by HR/back-office; the implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

listPrice.title: List price
listPrice.description: The fiscal catalog value in EUR -- the base the monthly bijtelling percentage is applied against (hrmq-asset-fleet-merge, absorbed from the retired Vehicle.cataloguswaarde). Meaningful only for category vehicle; null on every other category. Its completeness when category is vehicle is enforced by the corpus rule nl-asset-voertuig-fiscale-velden-compleet, not by a schema-level required (design.md D2).

fuelType.title: Fuel type
fuelType.description: Descriptive fuel type. Does not by itself select the bijtelling rate -- companyCarTaxCategory does. Meaningful only for category vehicle. Enum append-only: renaming a value later is breaking, adding one is not.

companyCarTaxCategory.title: Company car tax category
companyCarTaxCategory.description: The fiscal classification selecting which nl-{year}.json bijtellingPrivegebruikAuto rate/cap row applies: standard = the flat standardPercent rate over the full listPrice; evReducedCapped = the reduced evReducedPercent rate up to evReducedCataloguswaardeCap, standardPercent on the excess (fleet-bijtelling design.md D3). Meaningful only for category vehicle. Enum append-only -- the hydrogen/fully-solar uncapped rate and grijs-kenteken/bestelauto regimes are named non-goals, not modelled by an enum value here yet.

AssetAssignment.title: Asset assignment
AssetAssignment.description: An effective-dated custody assignment of one Asset to one Employee (the OrgAssignment pattern, hr-org.json): issuedOn required, returnedOn nullable = the asset is still out. For a vehicle Asset this is also the private-use holding period the bijtelling calculation resolves (hrmq-asset-fleet-merge, absorbed from the retired CarAssignment schema) -- employeeContribution is the employee's own monthly contribution for private use, meaningless (and harmlessly defaulted to 0) on a non-vehicle assignment. No x-openregister-lifecycle: a plain effective-dated record, no workflow. Consistency (coherent dates, the asset in status issued while the assignment is open) is enforced by nl-asset-assignment-consistency (lib/Standards/rules/labour.json / lib/Standards/Checks/NlAssetChecks.php), not by a write-time guard.

assetId.title: Asset
assetId.description: UUID reference to the issued Asset.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the receiving Employee.

issuedOn.title: Issued on
issuedOn.description: Issued on (effective-dating per the OrgAssignment pattern).

returnedOn.title: Returned on
returnedOn.description: Returned on; null while the asset is out. Must be on/after issuedOn when present (nl-asset-assignment-consistency).

issueReceiptSigned.title: Issue receipt signed
issueReceiptSigned.description: Whether a signed issue receipt is on file (the document itself lives in AssetDetail's Files widget).

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this AssetAssignment is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring the receiving employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

employeeContribution.title: Employee contribution
employeeContribution.description: The employee's own monthly contribution (EUR) for private use of a company car (Wet LB 1964 art. 13bis lid 5; hrmq-asset-fleet-merge, absorbed from the retired CarAssignment.eigenBijdrage). Subtracted from the computed monthly bijtelling, floored at zero -- never a negative bijtelling (fleet-bijtelling design.md D3). Meaningless -- and harmless at its default 0 -- for any non-vehicle assignment.
